description: Rewrite 'Disk is the bus' as a tighter, broader 'Disk first' principle and move it to the top of docs/PRINCIPLES.md. Disk-first is foundational: it is what makes git the substrate at all (history, branching, rollback, replay are git operations on data already on disk) and what eliminates entire classes of ephemeral-state bug (lost updates, stale caches, in-memory views drifting from on-disk truth).
title: docs: promote and tighten the disk-first principle
